messages:
sre-lead: Heads-up: were rebaselining some SLOs and running a short weekend loadtest. Window: Sat 03:00-06:00 UTC. Aim: reduce alert noise and validate new autoscaler tuning.

elaine: Summary of changes: p99 for inference routes from 100ms -> 140ms for a scheduled 03:00-05:30 UTC window. This is a planned, reversible policy; alerts will be suppressed for the window.

matt: Loadtest plan: progressive ramp 15m to 350rps, hold 30m, then ramp down. Scripts: tools/load/weekend_autoscaler_test.py. Well target non-prod + small fraction (1%) of prod as canary.

oncall: Ill be on pager. Abort criteria: error rate spike >0.6% or p99 for standard routes >300ms. Contact: @oncall.

ops-bot: scheduled: slo-rebaseline-20260710 window=2026-07-10T03:00:00Z/2026-07-10T06:00:00Z owner=@sre-lead id=mnt-20260710-slo.

elaine: Preflight checklist: run preflight 24h before, ensure kv-cache prefill jobs run 30m before, notify customers with reserved capacity >50k tokens. Ill handle customer email.

matt: After the hold period well run a short cold-start test to verify boot latency and autoscaler ramp speed. Postmortem slot Mon 09:00 PT.

sre-lead: Thanks. Please drop short notes here during and after the window. Well revert SLOs automatically at 06:05 UTC.
